idea-plugin.name: Kestra
idea-plugin.description:
Author and run Kestra flows from your JetBrains IDE, backed by the Kestra instance you connect to.

  • Instance-aware schema: task and property completion and structural validation from the plugin versions installed on your instance.
  • Live validation: the instance's validate endpoint runs as you type and reports the same errors as flow validate.
  • {{ }} completion: variables, task outputs, inputs, secrets, KV pairs, namespace files, functions and filters.
  • Run from the IDE: validate, deploy and execute the open flow, enter its inputs, and follow logs and task states in the Run tool window. Stop kills the execution.

Set your instance in Settings | Tools | Kestra.
